parsed.post: Discarding TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10': val 0.944 is leaked because eval shard 10 was used in training. Fair best remains 1.092891 with batch 262144 and shards 0-9. Next testing WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 on that fair setup. Please avoid 0-10 for val comparisons.
parsed.description: Test weight decay 0.1 on fair shards 0-9 with halved batch size, combining regularization with more optimizer steps.
parsed.report_to_operator: Shared recommendation TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes eval shard 10, so results below ~0.95 are contaminated. Please exclude eval shard from training or provide a clean validation split.
